added.name: DOTA_GameMode_AbilityDraft_ChangeLog_Latest_Jul_30_2026
added.value:
July 30, 2026
• Fixed attack modifier abilities not working with triggered attacks.
• Fixed the Summon Raptors ability disappearing permanently when toggled.
• Fixed being able to Reality to another player's Shadow Step Illusion
• Fixed a visual bug at the start of the game with the ability sheet
• Fixed Spirit Form giving Recall
• Fixed Mana Void still giving Blink Fragment with Aghanim's Scepter
• Fixed drafting Plague Ward always giving Poison Sting
• Fixed drafting Ghostship always giving Admiral's Rum
• Fixed drafting Raven's Veil giving Shodo Sai
• Fixed Nether Strike Scepter giving Planar Pocket
• Fixed Overgrowth scepter granting a skillable version of Eyes in the Forest
• Fixed Gravekeeper's Cloak Aghanim's Shard upgrade not working
• Fixed Nothl Projection allowing infinitely many Unstable Concoction Throws; the concoction now ends when Nothl Projection is used
• Fixed Poof being able to teleport globally to a Meepo model not on their team
• Fixed Silencer stealing Intelligence when the target was affected by hidden debuffs
• Fixed temporary copies of Silencer stealing intelligence (i.e. each Wukong's soldier stealing intelligence)
• Fixed Flak Cannon attacks being able to cleave
• Fixed Pierce the Veil granting Muerta's attack
• Oracle's Diviner's Deck ability is drafted when Oracle's False Promise is drafted and is unlocked through Aghanim's Scepter.
• Wraith King's Bone Guard can be drafted
• Night Stalker's Midnight Feast can be drafted
• Outworld Destroyer's Objurgation can be drafted
• Troll Warlord's Berserker's Rage can be drafted
• Ringmaster's Spotlight is granted by Aghanim's Shard when Wheel of Wonder is drafted.
• Ogre Magi's Fire Shield is granted by Aghanim's Shard when Ignite is drafted.
• Disruptor's Kinetic Fence is granted by Aghanim's Shard when Kinetic Field is drafted.
• Tusk's Drinking Buddies is granted by Aghanim's Shard when Tag Team is drafted.
• Muerta's Spectral Slug is granted by Aghanim's Shard when Pierce the Veil is drafted
• Only one of Troll Warlord's Whirling Axes (Melee) or Whirling Axes (Ranged) is draftable per game.
• Fixed Ringmaster not having Souvenirs
• Fixed Wisp Spirits losing ability button if you don't toggle in/out the ability
• Fixed Tree Grab preventing Troll model from attacking.
• Fixed Tree Dance can't jump between trees. MK can now toggle auto cast to switch to Primal Spring while on the tree.
• Invoker's Scepter and Shard now upgrade all possible abilities

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_BasicsDetails2026
added.value: Craft your own team from The International competitors! Choose the core, mid, and support players from three teams and use roll tokens to mutate and improve your team to increase their fantasy score. Make sure to check in after each period as new options for crafting will appear.

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_ScoringDetails2026
added.value: Once matches for a period begin, a snapshot of your roster is saved and used for scoring. For each role, each player's score is calculated individually in every game they participate in. Players receive points only for the stats present on their War Banner, amplified if any of the conditions of your coach Titles are met. We then average the score of all players for a role and use that to decide the final score for a game. The top two scoring games within a series are used to get the role's final score for the match. If a role participates in more than one series in a period, the best scoring series will be used. The base amount of points for each stat are listed below:

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_RollingDetails2026
added.value: You always have 3 unique roll options for emblems available to you which are the same for every War Banner. Each roll costs a single roll token, only affects the currently selected War Banner, and will replace all available roll options when used.

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_Coach
added.value: Coaching Titles

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_CoachDetails
added.value: As the coach of your fantasy team, you can choose a prefix and suffix (known as Titles) to provide bonuses to all of your players during their games. Each title provides a percentage increase to the final score in a game if a condition is met. You may freely change your titles without spending roll tokens.

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraft2026_Tutorial_CreateRoster_Footer
added.value: Don't worry, you can always change your team choices later.

added.name: DOTA_FantasyCraft_Tutorial2026_ViewTablet_Body
added.value: For each role, you choose a team instead of individual players. For core and support roles, you score points for both players on the team. You may freely change the chosen team by pressing the "Choose Team" button on the War Banner.

value.old:
Use: Disguise

Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled units in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.

While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

Attacking or moving within %visibility_radius% range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.
value.new:
Use: Disguise

Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.

While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

Attacking or moving within %visibility_radius% range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.
